board_page_description: Only the people on this list can sign in to Vecora. Each member gets access through a link you share with them.
board_role_description_admin: Everything, including managing the HOA board and other administrators, and viewing the "Activity log" of changes.
board_role_description_president: "Residential" (houses and residents), "Presidency" (periods and common areas), "HOA board" and the HOA's "Settings".
board_role_description_treasurer: "Treasury" (transactions, fees and categories), the "Presidency" periods, and paying or rejecting "Maintenance" and "Security" requests.
board_role_description_security: Sends payment requests in "Security" and can edit them while they're pending. Read-only in the other sections.
board_role_description_maintenance: Sends payment requests in "Maintenance" and can edit them while they're pending. Read-only in the other sections.
board_roles_hint: A person can have more than one role.
board_add_member_description: An account will be created for the resident and you'll get a link to share with them. With it, they can sign in to Vecora and create their password.
board_resident_hint: Only residents with an email on file who aren't on the board yet are listed. If someone's missing, add their email in the "Residential" section first.
board_remove_description: They'll lose all their roles and won't be able to sign in to the app anymore. Their past records (transactions, reservations) are kept. You can add them again later.
board_member_removed_description: {name} can no longer sign in to Vecora
board_invite_description: Share it by WhatsApp or copy it. When they open it, they can create their password, or reset it if they forgot it. The link can only be used once; if it gets lost or you need a new one, you can create it from the member's menu.
board_copy_failed_description: Select the link and copy it manually
board_whatsapp_message: Hi {name}, here's your access to Vecora. Open this link and create your password: {link}
board_main_admin_protected: The main admin account can't be removed or lose its role
board_only_admin_grant_admin: Only an administrator can grant the administrator role
board_resident_no_email: The resident has no email on file. Add it in the "Residential" section first.
board_resident_already_member: This resident is already on the HOA board
board_email_taken: An account with that email already exists and isn't linked to this resident
board_account_create_failed: Couldn't create the account, please try again
board_link_account_failed: Couldn't link the account to the resident, please try again
board_assign_roles_failed: Couldn't assign the roles, please try again
board_only_admin_link_admin: Only an administrator can create a link for another administrator
board_member_no_email: The member has no email on file
board_link_create_failed: Couldn't create the link, please try again
board_cannot_change_own_roles: You can't change your own roles. Ask another member to do it.
board_only_admin_change_admin: Only an administrator can grant or remove the administrator role
board_update_roles_failed: Couldn't update the roles, please try again
board_cannot_remove_self: You can't remove yourself from the HOA board
board_remove_member_failed: Couldn't remove the member, please try again
board_only_admin_remove_admin: Only an administrator can remove another administrator
board_password_save_failed: Couldn't save the password, please try again
board_password_saved_sign_in_failed: Your password was saved, but you couldn't be signed in. Sign in with it from the sign-in screen.
